e: Watashi tte shijô saijaku no Purikyua desu ka??
2-hitome no Purikyua wa yaruki manman desu!
Hayaku mo Purikyua konbi kaisan desu ka?
Kyohi sareta râmen! Oyako no kizuna naoshimasu!
Akogare no seitokaichô! Otomegokoro wa kakusemasen!!
Karisuma moderu no tameiki! Tte, naze desu ka?
Sukauto sareta otôsan! Ohanaya-san o yamechaimasu!?
Saidai no pinchi! Dâku Purikyua ga arawaremashita!
Achô!! Kanfû de pawâ appu shimasu!!
Shinjitsu ga akasaremasu! Kyua Mûnraito no shôtai!!
Namida no haha no hi! Kazoku no egao mamorimasu!!
Nanto! Seitokaichô ga kyûto na fuku kichaimasu!!
Raibaru wa Erika! Engeki-bu kara no chôsenjô desu!!
Mitomete kudasai! Watashi-tachi no Purikyua damashii!!
Saikyô densetsu! Banchô tôjô, yoroshiku desu!!
Namida no yomeiri! Chichi no hi kinen shashin desu!!
Daisan no yôsei! Popuri wa kawaii akachan desu!!
Yôsei adobenchâ! Purikyua sukauto sakusen desu!
Tsui ni mitsukemashita!! Sanninme no Purikyua!!
Kokoro no taiju no kiki! Purikyua, tobimasu!!
Umi e gô desu! Itsuki ukiuki natsu gashuku!
Yûki o dashite! Tomodachi ni naru tte suteki nan desu!!
Ojiichan wa ikemen-san? Kyua Furawâ no hatsukoi desu!
Sabâku shijô saidai no sakusen! Natsuyasumi no shukudai owarimasen!!
Natsu, rasuto supâto! Watashi no doresu dekimashita!!
Popuri ga iede! Itsuki, boroboro desu!!
Kanashimi no shôtai! Sore wa, Yuri-san no yôsei deshita...
Ikemen-san to taiketsu? Sonna no kitenai desu!!
Kyua Mûnraito, tsui ni fukatsu desu!!
Wakuwaku gakuensai! Fasshon-bu wa batabata desu!!
Minna ga shuyaku! Watashi-tachi no sutêji desu!!
Tsuyoku narimasu! Shiren wa Purikyua tai Purikyua!!
Purikyua, sûpâ shiruetto ni henshin desu!!
Erika pinchi! Marin takuto ga ubawaremashita!!
Sayonara Sasorina... Sabaku ni mo saku kokoro no hana desu!
Yôsei ga henshin!? Purikyua gekidan hajimemashita!!
Tomadoi no Yuri-san! Rabu retâ michaimashita...
Atarashii kazoku! Watashi, oneesan ni narimasu!!
Kurisumasu no kiseki! Kyua Furawâ ni aemashita!
Mô dame desu... Sekai ga sabaku ni narimashita...
Uso da to itte kudasai! Sabâku hakase no shôtai!!
Chikyû no tame! Yume no tame! Purikyua saigo no henshin desu!
Minna no kokoro o hitotsu ni! Watashi wa saikyô no Purikyua!!
